newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech to cut rates for certain features.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech to cut rates for certain features.

text.p: Ameritech said Friday the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio granted its request to lower rates for certain services to Ohio residential and business customers.

Ameritech said its residential customers will save $0.50 per month on its "caller ID with name" feature. In addition, one-time ordering charges for optional features like caller ID will be reduced by $0.75.
Business customers will see costs reduced on call waiting, specific toll rates and direct inward dialing functions.
The lower rates will take effect July 1, Ameritech said.
